# Ziddi Mumbaikar Website - Development Guidelines

This is a Next.js website for Ziddi Mumbaikar, a Mumbai-based NGO and citizen movement focused on community-driven social impact.

## Design System
- **Colors**: Primary orange/saffron (#f0750a), Navy blue (#0c1016), White backgrounds
- **Typography**: Poppins for body text, Montserrat for display headings
- **Style**: Bold, authentic, action-oriented, trustworthy
- **Target**: Mumbai citizens, local volunteers, people needing community help

## Key Features
- Modern responsive design with mobile-first approach
- Community-focused content with real impact stories
- Volunteer registration and help request forms
- Gallery showcasing real community work
- Strong call-to-action elements throughout

## Content Tone
- Authentic and grounded, not corporate
- Action-oriented language
- Focus on real results and transparency
- Use "we" not "they" - citizen-led perspective
- Mumbai-specific references and local context

## Technical Stack
- Next.js 14 with App Router
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Responsive design
- SEO-optimized structure

When generating code or content, prioritize community trust, authentic messaging, and clear calls-to-action that encourage civic participation.
